relation: Independent-seed confirmatory extension of M6.5, KEEPING ITS EXACT PRIMARY GATE. Uses unchanged M6.5 intervention algorithm; observational plus counterfactual fork, no physics edits.
motivation: M6.5 had directional isolation advantage to keeping rings intact at both densities but failed preregistered >=0.20 contrast at enriched density (0.1818). New seeds may or may not replicate effect.

fixed_sampling.selection: The first two distinct naturally formed four-ring material-ID sets in each world, in observation and sorted-ID order. Missing cases retained. No seed replacement, no treatment modification or post-outcome optimizations.

secondary_preregistered.ring_reclosure: Among open_lowest and open_opposite forks, count any observation of exact four-ID ring topology within 120 ticks; summarize first closure tick and within 10 ticks separately. This is spontaneous reclosure of a manipulated configuration, not self-repairing organism.
secondary_preregistered.isolation_time: Means of post-fork ticks of isolated four-source component for all arms and by density
secondary_preregistered.paired_discordances: Keep-only and open-only isolated at t=120 by density and precursor world (avoid treating two rings from the same world as independent).
secondary_preregistered.first_loss: Attachment vs fragmentation, first-loss observed and right-censored after 120 steps.
secondary_preregistered.overlap_caveat: The two selected rings per precursor can share background evolution and RNG stream and cannot be treated as independent worlds.

integrity.energy: All three arms conserve identical total energy at fork; edge opening releases stored bond energy to endpoints, changes topology, valence and energy distribution.
integrity.sham: Original M6.5 algorithm performs sham replay for first selected ring of first seed per density.
integrity.laws: No changes to src/alife physical laws or to historical detector/experiment.
integrity.initial_config: same 24x24 periodic natural background density regimes as M6.5

scientific_guardrails.interpretation: A fork contrast can suggest an effect of the combined edge-opening+energy redistribution intervention. It is not a pure-topology causal effect, life or heredity.
scientific_guardrails.negative: Do not adjust threshold if new results fail, do not silently pool with M6.5 for a new positive gate. If pooled, label exploratory.
scientific_guardrails.no_background_claims: Only say a CI process is active while its run actually executes.
